name: brain-cloud
description: Hosted Brain Memory over MCP. Sign in once (OAuth 2.1, Google) and get brain_recall, brain_memorize, brain_verify, brain_pin, brain_unpin, brain_forget, brain_status plus the Memory Inspector.

interface.shortDescription: Your Brain Memory, hosted, over MCP
interface.longDescription: Provenance-stamped, portable agent memory served from Brain Cloud (EU-hosted, encrypted at rest with server-side KMS). Works in ChatGPT desktop, Codex and Claude without a local install; syncs with the local brain plugin.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
Remember that I prefer concise answers.
